title: Version API v1 (neuronection.com /api/v1/versions/)
$comment: The family version-api contract (plan 48 / ADR-0048). Canonical in the family contract canonical, vendored byte-identical (neuronection-website scripts/contracts/, desktop-assistant contracts/ — presence-gated probe in the family wiring verifier). TWO documents share these defs: the family index and the per-product versions file — validate against #/$defs/familyIndex or #/$defs/productVersions respectively (the root matches anything on purpose). Discipline mirrors docs-tree.schema.json: draft 2020-12, only the keyword subset scripts/lib/docs-tree-validate.mjs implements (no oneOf/if-then/format/patternProperties here). TWO deliberate divergences from the content contracts: (1) additionalProperties stays OPEN on the response objects — the API evolves additively within schemaVersion 1 (ADR-0048 clause 4); a major bump is itself a family ADR, and closed shapes are reserved for that major; the generator is the only producer and check-versions.mjs re-asserts shape, so open objects cannot smuggle typos into consumers. (2) The channel law IS the schema: latestStable is a stableRelease (version carries no prerelease suffix, channel is const), latestBeta is a betaRelease (prerelease required) or null, and history items must match one or the other — a stable-shaped version on the beta channel cannot validate. Ordering/cross-field law (newest-first, latestBeta = max prerelease, no downgrades, legacy invariant, size budgets, index/product consistency) is check-versions.mjs's job, not the schema's. notes is the upstream release body stored verbatim: UNTRUSTED DATA — the hub renders it through a build-time allowlist renderer, desktop renders plain-text; never trust it as HTML.

semver.$comment: X.Y.Z with optional -prerelease; build metadata excluded (the family doesn't use it, and semver ignores it in comparisons). Never the `v` prefix — that lives in `tag`.

stableVersion.$comment: A stable version carries NO prerelease suffix (ADR-0048 clause 2).

betaVersion.$comment: A beta version REQUIRES the prerelease suffix (-rc.N / -beta.N / -alpha.N — one channel class).

isoDateTime.$comment: ISO 8601 date-time as the GitHub API emits it. (`format` is outside the mini-validator keyword subset — the pattern is the law.)

httpsUrl.$comment: Metadata-only API: every URL points at GitHub (a release page or a release asset).

repoSlug.$comment: GitHub owner/repo. Health publishes under a separate org (health-assistant-io/health-assistant) — by design, matched here.

productSlug.$comment: Repo-name slug: health-assistant, career-assistant, study-assistant, desktop-assistant. NOT the hub's internal site slugs (health/career/study/desktop) — the index maps the two via siteSlug.

checkInterval.$comment: Advisory polling hint (v1 builds emit 21600 = 6 h). Consumers clamp 15 min–24 h and add jitter; the API holds no per-client state (it is static files).

assetMap.$comment: platform → artifact-kind → download URL. Open vocabularies on purpose (platforms today: linux/windows/macos; kinds: appimage/deb/exe/msi/dmg/zip/apk…) — additive growth is the law. Every URL MUST resolve to the release's own GitHub assets.

tag.$comment: raw git tag, e.g. v0.10.0 — the human-facing link target

notes.$comment: upstream release body, markdown, stored verbatim — UNTRUSTED DATA. Hub: build-time allowlist renderer (github.com links only; images/raw HTML/external URLs dropped). Desktop: plain-text in v1. Never trust as HTML.

excerpt.$comment: markdown-stripped plain-text summary (≤400 chars) — the changelog-page/Atom-grade text. Optional; additive within v1 (ADR-0048 clause 4).

stableRelease.$comment: optional fields may be added within v1 (ADR-0048 clause 4) — consumers must tolerate unknown keys.

siteSlug.$comment: the hub's route slug — /{locale}/{siteSlug}/ (health, career, study, desktop). Maps API slugs to site pages.

latestBeta.$comment: null when no prerelease exists in the retained history; when present it may outrank latestStable (0.11.0-rc.1 > 0.10.0) — plain semver decides.

api.$comment: same-origin path of the authoritative per-product document

generatedAt.$comment: build time; the deploy smoke fails a build whose generatedAt is > 48 h old (stuck-sync alarm — staleness ≤ ~24 h is contractual, so 48 h means the sync stopped).

projects.$comment: DISCOVERY-ONLY — the per-product file is authoritative (CDN caches are per-URL, so index and product file can momentarily disagree across a deploy swap).

history.$comment: newest-first, stable+beta mixed. v1 builds cap at 25 entries (site policy, gate-enforced); 100 is the hard contract bound. Ordering, max-prerelease and no-downgrade law lives in check-versions.mjs.
